normalized_route_telemetry.normalization: The five retrieval-stage refusals made no provider call; their nullable provider fields are counted as zero requests, zero usage, zero fallback, zero repair, and no breaker observation.

sanitized_http_response_log.source: enterprise-doc-consumer logs within the execution window

limitations: The sealed evaluator report aggregates nullable no-call telemetry to null; this audit preserves the exact database totals and the no-call semantics without changing the sealed report.

HTTP response logs count visible responses, including provider-internal retries, and omit timeouts or connection failures; they are corroborating evidence rather than the route-counter source of truth.
Provider model revisions and billing amounts were not returned.
Primary failure cause is not persisted when fallback succeeds, so the 11 fallback transitions cannot be partitioned exactly into timeout, 429, 5xx, or transport causes from route telemetry alone.
